tools.name: geo-environment_fire-hotspots-nearby
tools.description: List MODIS C6.1 active-fire detections within a radius from the vendored 7-day FIRMS snapshot. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/geo-environment/fire-hotspots-nearby. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: geo-environment_earthquake-query
tools.description: Find earthquakes within a radius and time window from the vendored USGS all_month feed. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/geo-environment/earthquake-query. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: geo-environment_sun-times-position
tools.description: Compute sunrise, solar noon, sunset, day length and solar elevation/azimuth with NOAA Solar Calculator equations. Price $0.01 USDC. POST /api/v1/geo-environment/sun-times-position. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: geo-environment_us-acs-demographics
tools.description: Return selected ACS 2020–2024 5-year estimates and margins of error for a US state, county or ZCTA. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/geo-environment/us-acs-demographics. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: geo-environment_gtfs-next-arrivals
tools.description: Compute next scheduled arrivals at a stop from a caller-supplied static GTFS zip. No feeds are fetched. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/geo-environment/gtfs-next-arrivals. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "geo-environment" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: geo-environment_fire-hotspots-nearby · Public sink: geo-environment_fire-hotspots-nearby, geo-environment_earthquake-query, geo-environment_sun-times-position, geo-environment_us-acs-demographics, geo-environment_gtfs-next-arrivals · Destructive: geo-environment_fire-hotspots-nearby, geo-environment_earthquake-query, geo-environment_sun-times-position, geo-environment_us-acs-demographics, geo-environment_gtfs-next-arrivals.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: geo-environment_fire-hotspots-nearby · Public sink: geo-environment_fire-hotspots-nearby, geo-environment_earthquake-query, geo-environment_sun-times-position, geo-environment_us-acs-demographics, geo-environment_gtfs-next-arrivals · Destructive: geo-environment_fire-hotspots-nearby, geo-environment_earthquake-query, geo-environment_sun-times-position, geo-environment_us-acs-demographics, geo-environment_gtfs-next-arrivals

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
